basic_profile.bio: I'm a 29-year-old graphic designer based in Portland, Oregon. I have a huge passion for tabletop role-playing games, especially The Witcher TRPG, and I often spend my weekends immersed in fantasy worlds with friends. I also enjoy exploring new shower thoughts, particularly about dogs. When I'm not working or gaming, I like to engage in various puzzles, with safecracking being a recent interest. I'm in a long-term relationship with my partner of five years, and we share an apartment with our two rescue dogs. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after work, around 7-10 PM PST.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in Graphic Design from a local university. My interest in fantasy games and stories led me to self-teach The Witcher TRPG's rules and lore, which I now consider myself somewhat of an expert on. I am also self-taught in safecracking, a hobby I picked up from watching documentaries and online tutorials.
